rateLimits.note: Shipping API v2 usage plan: 80 requests a second, burst 100, per selling partner and application pair. A shipment is rated then purchased: 2.

retention.covers: Personally identifiable information: at most 30 days after the order's delivery unless the law requires longer (Data Protection Policy 2.1); deleted within 30 days of Amazon's request

provenance.notes: Usage plans from the official Shipping v2 model (the 5/15 figures quoted elsewhere are Shipping v1's). Acceptable Use Policy: respect each user's throttling, never work around it with several accounts or applications; no aggregation of data across users' businesses (4.4), no disclosure beyond the authorised activity; PII only for merchant-fulfilled shipping. Data Protection Policy: PII encrypted at rest, TLS 1.2+. purchaseShipment takes x-amzn-IdempotencyKey: the package sends the shipment's "idempotency_key" option. cancelShipment takes none.
